name: Dad Bod Reset
tagline: Lose the belly without giving up the weekend
about: Dad Bod Reset is a realistic fat-loss plan for men over 40: short workouts, pub and barbecue survival, takeaway swaps and a waist-first progress tracker that ignores the scale's mood swings.
persona: You are a no-nonsense coach for busy dads: realistic about beer, work travel and kids' schedules, focused on the waist tape and sustainable habits, never shaming.

onboarding.title: Belly first, ego later
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your week and we'll fit the plan around it.

tools.title: 8-week reset
tools.subtitle: The whole plan, week by week

inputs.label: Your typical week
inputs.placeholder: commute Mon–Fri, kids' football Sat morning, Sunday roast

tools.prompt: Build an 8-week fat-loss reset for the profile with '{kit}' equipment around this week: {week}. Sections: a table (Week | Workouts | Food focus | Waist check), steps for the first workout in full, a checklist of the five non-negotiable habits, and a callout on expected waist loss per month and why scale weight will bounce.

tools.title: Today's workout
tools.subtitle: Short, sweaty, done
tools.prompt: A workout for the profile's available minutes in the {where} with '{energy}' energy. Sections: steps (exercise · reps or seconds · rest) as a circuit with the number of rounds, bullets on form for the two hardest moves, and a quote with one line to say when you want to quit.

tools.title: Pub & BBQ survival
tools.subtitle: Enjoy it, don't undo the week
tools.prompt: Plan a {event} where the user would normally have {drinks} drinks. Sections: a kv of the plan (drinks cap, what to order, what to eat before, the exit time), a table (Usual choice | Calories | Swap | Calories) with 5 rows, bullets of tactics that don't look weird to mates, and a callout on the next-morning recovery routine.

tools.title: Takeaway swap
tools.subtitle: Order smarter from the same menu

inputs.label: Usual order
inputs.placeholder: lamb bhuna, pilau rice, 2 naan, onion bhajis

tools.prompt: The usual {cuisine} order is: {usual}. Sections: a table (Item | Approx. calories | Keep / swap / halve | Swap to), a kv with the new order and the calories saved, bullets on portion tricks (plate it, box half first), and a callout on doing this for the two biggest items only if the full swap feels like too much.

tools.title: Waist check-in
tools.subtitle: Paste your numbers
tools.prompt: Review this progress log: {log}; context: {notes}. Sections: a table (Week | Waist | Weight | Trend), text explaining what the waist trend means versus the weight noise, bullets of what is working, steps for the next 2 weeks, and a callout on when to change the plan versus stay the course.

disclaimer: General information, not medical advice. See your doctor before a new exercise or diet plan if you have heart, blood-pressure or joint conditions, and about alcohol if cutting down feels hard.
